reason: PURE. What I noticed first was the little pocket sachets that tear open with one hand, because I live out of a tote bag and my vitamins sit on the kitchen counter while I forget them. I would try one box at $29.99, but only once to see if I actually remember to take it.
objection: $29.99 is double what I paid for Toplux 8 forms in a flash sale, and that bottle lasts 3 months. I am paying a lot extra for the packaging.
would_change_my_mind: A first-box price around $20 to $22, or a small trial pack, so I can see if the sachets really fix my forgetting before I commit to a full month.
